title: Tiny, cute tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tent body left panel -->
  <polygon points='50,18 12,82 50,82' fill='#e8734a' stroke='#f4a07a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Tent body right panel -->
  <polygon points='50,18 88,82 50,82' fill='#c95a35' stroke='#e88a5e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Center seam highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#f7c6a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- Tent opening -->
  <polygon points='50,40 36,82 64,82' fill='#3a2a6e' stroke='#5d4a9e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Opening inner glow (door flap light) -->
  <polygon points='50,48 41,82 59,82' fill='#f7d86b' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- Ridge pole top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='4' fill='#f7d86b' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Guy rope left -->
  <line x1='18' y1='76' x2='6' y2='88' stroke='#9a8fd0' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='6' cy='88' r='2.5' fill='#c9a44a'/>
  <!-- Guy rope right -->
  <line x1='82' y1='76' x2='94' y2='88' stroke='#9a8fd0' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='88' r='2.5' fill='#c9a44a'/>
  <!-- Ground line -->
  <line x1='8' y1='84' x2='92' y2='84' stroke='#6b5fa8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Cute flag on top -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='50' y2='4' stroke='#f7d86b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,4 62,8 50,12' fill='#7ed4e6' stroke='#a8e6f2' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Little star decorations on tent -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='2' fill='#f7d86b' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='2' fill='#f7d86b' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='1.6' fill='#ffe89a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
